body.x: Brato (CEO In-bae Kim) participated in the 2024 Future Innovation Tech Expo (FIX 2024), held at EXCO from October 23 (Wednesday) to October 26 (Saturday).

Brato specializes in manufacturing low-backlash reducers with planetary gear systems for servo motors. Supported by advanced design analysis, production technology, and expertise, Brato’s planetary reducers achieve low backlash without preload and offer high efficiency, low noise, and robust durability.

These reducers are suitable for precision control and high-torque transmission in industrial robots, transport robots, automation systems, factory machinery, automation equipment, LCD equipment, shipbuilding machinery, and packaging machines.

At FIX 2024, Brato showcased the BP Series, its planetary gear reducer designed for direct connection to servo motors. It features high precision and rigidity, with the servo motor directly mounted and aligned coaxially with the drive unit.

body.cap: Brato’s BP Series reducer | Photo by AVING News

body.x: The servo motor’s output shaft connects to the input pinion of the planetary reducer’s sun gear. As the sun gear rotates, three planetary gears engage with its teeth and revolve along the internal gear’s inner teeth. This motion transmits through the planetary shafts to the carrier, aligning the reducer’s output shaft rotation with the input shaft direction.

A Brato representative stated, “We are a specialized manufacturer of planetary reducers for servo motors. We have successfully localized production. Our products are known for their fast delivery, competitive pricing, and excellent durability. We currently export to various international markets, including China, Vietnam, North America, Alabama, and Thailand.”

body.x: FIX 2024 featured specialized exhibitions, conferences, and business programs focusing on mobility, robotics, AI, and startups. The Daegu International Future Auto & Mobility Expo 2024 at EXCO’s East Wing showcased trends in UAM, autonomous driving, batteries, components, and services. Meanwhile, the 2024 ICT Convergence Expo Korea, held in the West Wing, exhibited AI, big data, blockchain, ICT, and metaverse technologies. The 2024 Daegu Robot Expo displayed industrial robots, humanoid robots, and digital transformation solutions for the robotics industry. The “Startup Arena” was introduced to facilitate meetings between startups and experts from startup accelerators like Samsung C-Lab and Plug and Play.
